versions.s: Man became a living soul. The same phrase is used of the animals.
Flesh with the life thereof, which is the blood thereof, shall ye not eat. Life and blood are named with the same word, nephesh.
His life is bound up in the lad's life. Nephesh, the same word as living soul, used twice, bound together.
The iron entered into his soul. The Hebrew more literally reads his soul came into iron, a difficult phrase ancient translators handled differently.
